name: human-direct-invest
notes: H1 (docs/HUMAN-AI.md): AI direct investment never fires in vanilla (precedence bug makes the influence budget 0.1/0.2). With the fix, AI factions fund priorities in their majority-controlled nations. First run (2026-10-18): mod 1 investment (Exodus MissionControl) vs vanilla 0 in 120 days: the bug is real and fixed, but low impact (10% of influence rarely covers a priority).
